A1.justification: Both PDFs describe ReflecTool and ClinicalAgent Bench (CAB). Their main text, equations, figures, tables, and appendices A–D are readable and matchable despite additions and renumbering.

before.justification: v2 reports original CAB evaluations, component ablations, sensitivity experiments, and tool-use analyses, including Tables 2–5 and the detailed appendix Table 7.

after.justification: v3 retains those original experiments and adds tool/task error breakdowns, Llama backbone results, and runtime measurements in Tables 6–8.

M1.justification: The optimization/inference stages, long-term memory, tool-wise experience, and two verification procedures remain unchanged, as do Algorithm 1 and the appendix prompts. The additional Llama evaluation does not establish a change to the proposed algorithm.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same 18 CAB tasks across five dimensions, with matching dataset descriptions and input scenarios. The new analyses and backbone evaluation use retained coverage.

E2.justification: Existing empirical comparator sets are retained, and the new analyses reuse ReAct, Reflexion, and CRITIC. OmniRAG is added only to Table 1's qualitative capability comparison, without reported benchmark evaluation.

E3.justification: v3 adds Llama3-70B-Instruct agent evaluation on the ablation subset with adjusted prompts, tool/task-conditioned error measurements, and per-sample timing tests. Previously stated benchmark settings, ablation sampling, and implementation protocols remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Sections 5.5–5.7 substantially broaden supplementary analysis: aggregate tool-selection errors gain tool/task breakdowns, an additional backbone tests applicability beyond Qwen, and runtime comparisons examine efficiency. Existing component ablations, sensitivity plots, and Appendix C's parameter-error case study are retained.

E5.justification: The Table 2 significance thresholds and reporting convention remain unchanged, with no added seed counts, repeated-run information, confidence intervals, or statistical procedures. One removed significance marker changes a reported outcome, assessed under E6.

E6.justification: Tables 6–8 add substantial results on error distributions, Llama performance, and runtime. Llama scores are 62.26 for refinement, 60.72 for selection, and 58.78 for Reflexion; Qwen2-72B runtimes are respectively 47.90, 28.56, and 57.27 seconds per sample. These are newly reported comparisons, not improvements over corresponding v2 scores. Existing numerical results are retained, but Table 2 removes the p<0.01 marker from the unchanged 48.60 Qwen2-7B refinement Trust score.

T1.justification: The task/action definitions, Equations 1–9, and Algorithm 1 retain the same mathematical content. Neither version adds theoretical propositions or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introductory contribution statements, and conclusion retain the same claims about CAB, reflection-guided tool use, verification variants, and performance advantages. The new experiments support existing claims without revising their stated scope.

C2.justification: v3 adds interpretations concerning input-format confusion in tool selection, Llama instruction-following difficulties and model generalization, and parallelism/tool invocation as explanations for runtime differences. The existing limitations and appendix applicability discussion remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Section 5.6 adds the Llama checkpoint reference and discloses prompt adjustment, although the adjusted prompts are not supplied. Existing toolbox implementation details, Appendix D's hardware and prompt documentation, and code/data access information are retained.

R1.justification: v3 adds OmniRAG (Chen et al., 2025) to Table 1 and the bibliography. The remaining related-work discussion and positioning are substantively unchanged.

P1.justification: Tool Usage Error moves from Section 5.1 to 5.5, accompanied by local renumbering and the new analysis sections. Acknowledgements and related-work subheadings are added, including an empty Appendix A.2 heading; most existing prose is retained.

P2.justification: v3 adds Tables 6–8 and an OmniRAG row in Table 1, and relocates existing analysis displays. All eleven figures and the existing tables are retained, with renumbering and page reflow rather than a broad visual redesign.

improvement.justification: Compared with v2's Qwen-only agent evaluations, v3 adds a useful backbone check and makes failure patterns and runtime costs more assessable through Tables 6–8. These strengthen empirical scrutiny, but unspecified Llama prompt adjustments and limited timing/statistical detail constrain the added generalization and efficiency interpretations. The overall quality gain is positive but limited.
